cases.raw_output:
theory LiveSecureChallenge

begin

// Function signature and definition of the equational theory E

functions: fst/1, h/1, pair/2, snd/1
equations: fst(<x.1, x.2>) = x.1, snd(<x.1, x.2>) = x.2

rule (modulo E) Create_Secret:
   [ Fr( ~k ) ] --[ Secret( ~k ) ]-> [ St_Init( ~k ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Begin:
   [ Fr( ~n ) ] --[ BeginChallenge( ~n ) ]-> [ Out( h(~n) ), St_Sent( ~n ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Accept:
   [ In( h(n) ), St_Sent( n ) ] --[ AcceptChallenge( n ) ]-> [ ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma secrecy_claim:
  all-traces "∀ k #i. (Secret( k ) @ #i) ⇒ (¬(∃ #j. K( k ) @ #j))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ k #i. (Secret( k ) @ #i) ∧ ∃ #j. (K( k ) @ #j)"
*/
simplify
by solve( !KU( ~k ) @ #vk )

lemma auth_claim:
  all-traces
  "∀ n #i. (AcceptChallenge( n ) @ #i) ⇒ (∃ #j. BeginChallenge( n ) @ #j)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ n #i.
  (AcceptChallenge( n ) @ #i) ∧ ∀ #j. (BeginChallenge( n ) @ #j) ⇒ ⊥"
*/
simplify
solve( St_Sent( n ) ▶₁ #i )
  case Begin
  by contradiction /* from formulas */
qed

/* All wellformedness checks were successful. */

theory LiveSecureChallenge
begin
builtins: hashing

rule Create_Secret:
  [ Fr(~k) ]
  --[ Secret(~k) ]->
  [ St_Init(~k) ]

rule Begin:
  [ Fr(~n) ]
  --[ BeginChallenge(~n) ]->
  [ Out(h(~n)), St_Sent(~n) ]

rule Accept:
  [ In(h(n)), St_Sent(n) ]
  --[ AcceptChallenge(n) ]->
  [ ]

lemma secrecy_claim:
  "All k #i. Secret(k) @ i ==> not (Ex #j. K(k) @ j)"

lemma auth_claim:
  "All n #i. AcceptChallenge(n) @ i ==> (Ex #j. BeginChallenge(n) @ j)"
end
